scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.format:backend: python -m isort backend/app backend/tests && python -m black backend/app backend/tests
scripts.format:backend:check: python -m isort --check-only backend/app backend/tests && python -m black --check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.typecheck:backend: python -m mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app/config.py backend/app/core/password_policy.py backend/app/core/exceptions.py
